items.reason: Verifier results write timestamped documents under the set’s verify/ directory.
Reports are written once after fallback completes, with collision handling preserving earlier reports.
The response contract keeps VERDICT first; report extraction removes that line and retains the prose.
Verdict parsing is unchanged, and malformed replies retain their raw text in the report.
Report creation runs for PASS, FIXABLE, and NEEDS-HUMAN.
The response contract explicitly requires PASS findings explaining checks and each criterion.
Cache hits return before report creation.
Invalidation still deletes verdict rows without touching report files.
Previous reports never enter the Verifier prompt; prior human-note handling remains unchanged.
The human acceptance path writes a report without invoking an agent.
Human reports include the supplied rationale and overridden verdict.
Human authorship is explicit in both the header and report body.
Human reports use the same writer, directory, timestamp format, headers, and latest-report lookup.
The gate renders the latest report’s path and recorded commit without its body.
The Verify paging action opens the document and returns to the gate menu.
The task-set detail renderer adds a Verify report pointer.
Artifact ordering places Verify reports ahead of Refine reports.
Agent prompt views gain no Verify pointer; only Verifier response-contract goldens change.
Missing Verify reports produce no Verify preamble, paging entry, detail section, or artifact.
Verification status and verified-at badge derivation remain independent of report age.
Compact status rows retain truncated findings but gain no adjacent report pointer; the pointer appears only in the separate detail view.
Both passes share parameterized rendering, storage, latest-report scanning, and document-header parsing.
Refine retains its filename format, directory, headers, prompt content, and existing rendering.
Refiner prompt golden files are unchanged.

scores.rationale: Clear shared machinery and useful regression tests; the compact-row pointer requirement is missed. Assessed statically from the parent tree and supplied diff.
